limits: Only explicit completed/refused record groups are selected; no instrument ownership or final bench state is inferred.
Controller success alone did not prove image integrity: the first IDMA build wrote zeros and remains failed.
LINE overlap used warm preinitialized SD and diagnostic snapshots; it is not a cold-start energy measurement or a PVT visibility guarantee.
All-capacity format initializes slot headers; it does not validate physical capacity, erase every payload sector, or qualify arbitrary power loss.
Scene photo pixels are omitted. Captured payloads here are explicitly verified test-pattern runs or their failed SD readback.
Frozen generated sources and binary bytes are retained; external vendor/toolchain dependencies are not a portable build closure.
Tool files are labeled archive-time snapshots, not asserted to be the exact versions executed for every historical run.
